products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Slurricane - 1G - Live Rosin
products.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals presents Slurricane Live Rosin, a premium 1g concentrate that showcases the full essence of this celebrated strain. This extract is crafted using solventless extraction methods, preserving the plant's natural terpene profile and cannabinoids for an authentic, full-spectrum experience. Slurricane delivers a rich, sweet flavor profile with notes of berry, grape, and creamy tropical fruit, complemented by earthy undertones. The aroma is equally captivating, offering a pungent blend of fruity sweetness and subtle spice. Live rosin enthusiasts appreciate this product for its potent effects that promote deep relaxation, euphoria, and relief, making it ideal for unwinding after a long day or easing into restful sleep. The 1g size provides excellent value for dabbing connoisseurs who demand quality and flavor in every session. Experience the difference that solventless craftsmanship brings with Sweetgrass Botanicals Slurricane Live Rosin.

products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Cereal Milk - 1G - Live Rosin
products.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals presents Cereal Milk Live Rosin, a premium 1g extract crafted using solventless extraction methods to preserve the plant's full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes. This artisanal concentrate delivers the strain's signature creamy, sweet flavor profile with subtle notes of vanilla and citrus, reminiscent of the milk left after a bowl of your favorite cereal. Live Rosin represents the pinnacle of cannabis extraction, utilizing fresh frozen material to capture the plant's essence at its peak. The result is a smooth, flavorful concentrate that offers potent effects and exceptional purity. Perfect for discerning consumers seeking premium quality and authentic taste, this 1g jar provides multiple sessions of rich, terpene-forward dabbing experiences. Ideal for concentrate enthusiasts who appreciate craft cannabis products made with meticulous attention to detail and quality.

products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Cherry Whip - 1G Dry Sift
products.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals presents Cherry Whip, a premium 1g dry sift kief extract that delivers concentrated cannabis goodness in its purest form. This finely-sifted kief captures the essence of the Cherry Whip strain, offering sweet cherry flavors with creamy, fruity undertones that delight the palate. As a potent extract, this dry sift provides elevated effects perfect for experienced consumers seeking enhanced relaxation and euphoria. The crystalline texture and rich terpene profile make it ideal for topping bowls, rolling into joints, or pressing into rosin. Each gram showcases Sweetgrass Botanicals' commitment to quality extraction methods that preserve the plant's natural compounds. Whether you're looking to elevate your flower or enjoy kief on its own, Cherry Whip delivers a flavorful, potent experience that captures the full character of this delicious strain in convenient 1g packaging.

image.alt: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Cherry Whip - 1G Dry Sift

products.name: Sweetgrass Botanicals - Dante's Lemons - 1G - Live Rosin

This solventless concentrate showcases the brand's commitment to quality and purity, delivering an authentic terpene-rich experience. Sweetgrass Botanicals' meticulous craftsmanship shines through in every golden drop of this exceptional live rosin.

products.name: Harbor House - Lemon Cherry Sherbert - 1G Badder
products.description: Harbor House delivers premium concentrate craftsmanship with their Lemon Cherry Sherbert 1G Badder. This velvety extract showcases a delightful fusion of zesty lemon, sweet cherry, and creamy sherbet notes that dance across the palate. The badder consistency offers easy handling and versatile dabbing for concentrate enthusiasts seeking potent, flavorful sessions. Lemon Cherry Sherbert is known for delivering balanced effects that inspire creativity and euphoria while maintaining relaxation—perfect for unwinding after a long day or enhancing social gatherings. Each dab reveals complex terpene profiles with bright citrus top notes complemented by fruity cherry undertones and a smooth, creamy finish. Harbor House's meticulous extraction process preserves the strain's natural essence, resulting in a concentrate that's as flavorful as it is effective. Ideal for experienced users who appreciate quality extracts with exceptional taste and reliable potency.
